items.implication: Daniels QB1; boosts McLaurin and WAS pass catchers.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Foot injury; ETR had not expected.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston or other Chargers WRs elevated targets/snaps.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play; Terry McLaurin will play.
items.why: ETR live final updates after pregame workouts; Jeanty plantar/ankle, McLaurin hamstring.
items.implication: Jeanty RB2 viable if unlimited; McLaurin WR2/3 with Daniels returning.
items.opportunity: Jeanty carries/snaps; McLaurin routes with Daniels back.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after hopeful GTD status and pregame workout for plantar fasciitis/ankle.
items.why: Sources confirm after elevated backup RB.
items.implication: Start Jeanty as RB2; monitor snap limits.
items.opportunity: Primary back role if healthy enough.

items.text: Justin Jefferson is active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Official actives; Jefferson ankle, Addison hamstring.
items.implication: Jefferson gets full target share opportunity in homecoming; Addison out elevates Jefferson/Hockenson further until Hock out later.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after being listed questionable.
items.why: ETR final weekend summary update; full practice Friday.
items.implication: Full Bengals WR corps available; Chase remains WR1, Higgins high-end WR2/3.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/route share expected for both.

items.text: Weekend summary: NOT EXPECTED - Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer. GTD - JJ/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED - Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Keenan Allen.
items.why: Critical Sunday AM pulse; messiest injury week.
items.implication: Sit not-expecteds; monitor GTDs closely; start expecteds confidently.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for outs like Dowdle (Warren), MHJ (Wilson).

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive for Sunday vs Lions as Cardinals finalize trade details; informed this morning.
items.implication: Zero fantasy this week; change of scenery possible boost ROS.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and others full target share vs DET.

items.text: Coaching staffs refuse to go workhorse on Jaylen Warren including this one splitting with Rico Dowdle pre-injury. Warren passes every test, Austin Ekeler-esque.
items.why: Advanced stats/eye test; Dowdle not expected.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with Dowdle out; potential lead back.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: Sit Monty; Joe Mixon or backups elevated if applicable.

items.text: George Kittle has an illness but is expected to play and officially active vs Seahawks.
Vikings ruled out TE TJ Hockenson due to concussion; Aaron Jones Sr. questionable to return with knee.
items.implication: Jefferson even more volume; backup TEs.

items.text: Caleb Williams inactive; actives include Keenan Allen, Jaylen Wright, Terry McLaurin, Ashton Jeanty. Inactives also Jordan Addison.
items.why: Official; hamstring, chance next week per Rap.
items.implication: Bears backup QB; no Williams fantasy value this week.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming if any; Bears skill players with limited ceiling.

items.text: Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Keenan Allen expected to play.
items.implication: Start these with confidence as usual roles.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor; elevates Michael Wilson/Kendrick Bourne. Kia Kendrick Bourne szn with MHJ inactive/trade.
items.why: Usage data: MHJ non-factor even when playing; quotes ETR context.
items.implication: Wilson WR3/flex upside vs DET secondary without MHJ.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN, Michael Wilson WR10 (MHJ out), Christian Watson, Isaiah Likely TE5, Chase Brown RB5. Hates Jordan Addison.
items.why: Target volume, red-zone, matchups; MHJ inactive cruel for owners but boosts Wilson.
items.implication: Start these loves; fade Addison even if active.
items.opportunity: Collins/Wilson volume; Brown carries/targets; Likely with Lamar out.

items.text: Messiest injury week remembered; still docks on guys playing through injury. Rain totals dropping: CLE-NYJ to 38.5, IND-PIT 42, NYG-WAS 41.5.
items.why: No full Bengals WR info initially; many GTDs; weather impact.
items.implication: Lower totals dampen passing games in rain spots; careful with docks.

items.text: Cruelest thing for MHJ drafters is inactive vs Lions secondary. Lamar to Tyler Huntley is downgrade but doesn't really matter for fantasy purposes in context.
items.implication: Avoid MHJ; start Likely/Ravens pass catchers with Huntley.
